transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?

Um... I suppose I just don't really feel like myself anymore. I don't know. I used to make time for things... painting, hiking, going to choir. Even just the usual Sunday gatherings with my family. But now... I don't know, even if I have a free hour, I just sit there. I just can't seem to care about any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I suppose... maybe eight months. It's been building up since I took over this STEM-Arts curriculum initiative at work. Just... around then, I guess.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things that you used to enjoy, like painting, hiking, or spending time with your family?
Yeah... I think I mentioned that. I just... I don't get anything out of them anymore. Like I said, I just sit there. I don't really want to do any of it.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you’re not worth much?

I suppose... maybe a little. Just... with work. That curriculum project. If even a small thing goes wrong with it, I... I just get it in my head that I'm letting the students down. And... I don't know. My parents sacrificed a lot for me to have this kind of opportunity. I just feel like I'm wasting it all.
Have you noticed that you feel tired or lack energy a lot of the time, even if you haven't been doing anything physically demanding?
I don't think so... I mean, I get tired after work, but I guess that's just normal. I haven't really noticed feeling any different energy-wise.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the contrary, feeling restless or fidgety without being able to relax?
No... I haven't really noticed anything like that. I think I just move and talk like I normally do.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently?
I don't think so. I haven't really been paying attention to my weight... and my appetite seems about the same, I guess. I haven't noticed any big changes.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down or lost interest in things, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way?
Um... I don't think so. I haven't really thought about it, but... no, I don't think I've ever felt quite like this before. It's just recently, I guess.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt down or lost interest in things for several weeks or more?
No... I think I just said that. I don't remember feeling this way before.
Have you had any thoughts about death, or wished you were dead, or even thought about hurting yourself?

Um... well... I guess sometimes. Like, on late nights when I'm in the studio... I sometimes catch myself thinking it would just be a relief if I didn't wake up. 

I haven't made a plan or anything to actually hurt myself. But... I guess those thoughts scared me enough that I finally told my husband. I just told him I couldn't keep handling them by myself.

Can you think back and confirm if you have ever had any other times in your life, even shorter or less intense than this one, where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than a couple of weeks?
I... I really don't think so. I mean, I've already answered this, haven't I? I just... I don't remember anything like this happening before. It's just been lately.
Looking back over your life, have you ever had any other times — even if just for a few weeks or not as bad as now — when you felt down or lost interest in things?
I... no. I don't know why you keep asking me that. Like I said, I really haven't. It's just been this time.

Looking back, are you absolutely sure there has never been another time — even if just for a short while or not as intense as now — when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than a couple of weeks?
I... I'm sure. I don't... I don't have anything else to say about it. I've never felt this way before.
